title: Protocol for Imaging and Analysis of Mouse Tumor Models with CUBIC Tissue Clearing
protocol: Sacrifice tumor-bearing mice by overdose of pentobarbital or isoflurane.
Perfuse PBS through the left ventricle using a syringe with a 23G needle, perfusing approximately 20–25 mL.
Change solution to 4% PFA and perfuse another 20–25 mL through the same route.
Excise organs after perfusion.
Immerse excised organs into 4% PFA and shake gently at 4°C overnight (12–16 hours).
Wash samples with PBS to remove 4% PFA.
Exchange solution from PFA to PBS, shaking gently for more than 2 hours.
Repeat PBS washes over two exchanges, ensuring total washing time exceeds 6 hours.
Transfer organs to 50% CUBIC-L and shake gently at 37°C (50–100 rpm).
After over 6 hours of incubation in 50% CUBIC-L, exchange solution with 100% CUBIC-L.
Shake gently at 37°C for 1–7 days until the exchanged CUBIC-L solution is no longer colored.
Wash samples with PBS to remove CUBIC-L.
Exchange solution from CUBIC-L to PBS and shake gently for more than 2 h.
Exchange PBS more than 2 times (total wash > 6 h).
Stain samples with antibody if required for 3D staining.
Immerse samples with antibody dilution in staining buffer.
Shake gently at 22°C for 3 days, protecting from light.
Remove antibody solution and wash in PBS.
Exchange solution from antibody solution to PBS and shake gently for more than 2 h.
Exchange PBS more than 2–4 times (total wash > 6 h).
Centrifuge diluted antibodies to remove precipitate aggregates (1,000–1,500 × g for 15 min) if needed.
Immerse entire organs in staining buffer using a container with a round bottom.
Use fluorescent dye or fluorescence proteins conjugated primary antibodies for uniform deep staining.
Decalcify bone samples in decalcification solution (i.e., osteosoft).
Remove air from samples using vacuum desiccator (10–20 in/hg) if needed.
Leave bone samples at 18°C–26°C for 5–7 days after decalcification.
Wash samples with PBS to remove antibody solution.
Exchange solution from antibody solution to PBS and shake gently for more than 2 h.
Exchange solution to 50% CUBIC-R (N) and shake gently at 18°C–26°C for more than 6 h, protecting from light.
Exchange solution to 100% CUBIC-R (N) and shake gently at 18°C–26°C overnight (12–16 h), protecting from light.
Take images of cleared tissue samples with LSFM or confocal microscopy.
Wash samples in CUBIC-R (N) with observation oil.
Put samples into a glass container filled with observation oil.
Collect images by light sheet fluorescent microscopy (LSFM) at 10 μm step size.
Record images in TIFF format.
Analyze data with Imaris software.
Wash samples with PBS.
Place samples into PBS and shake gently for more than 2 hours.
Exchange PBS more than two times, ensuring a total wash duration of over 6 hours.
Embed samples into paraffin using equipment including dehydration and delipidation processes with ethanol and xylene.
Make sections using standard histology microtome and mount on glass slide.
Deparaffinize slides with xylene.
Immerse slides in endogenous peroxidase blocking solution.
Incubate them at 18°C–26°C for 15–20 min.
Wash with tap water or TBS.
Immerse slides into HIER.
Autoclave them at 121°C for 10 min.
Chill them to 18°C–26°C.
Wash with TBS, rinse with water.
Dry the slides.
Cover with the first antibody and incubate in a humidified chamber for 2 h to 16 h.
Wash with TBS.
Exchange solution to TBS and still for 3 min.
Repeat washing step more than two times.
Add second antibody labeled with biotin and incubate at 40°C for 30 min.
Wash with TBS.
Exchange solution to TBS and still for 3 min.
Repeat washing step more than two times.
Add ABC reagent and incubate at 40°C for 20–30 min.
Wash with TBS.
Exchange solution to TBS and still for 3 min.
Repeat washing step more than two times.
DAB coloring by adding DAB dilution and incubating for 2–3 min at 18°C–26°C.
Wash with TBS.
Stain nucleus with Meyer.
Wash with tap water.
Dehydrate with ethanol and xylene.
Mount slides with coverslip using mounting agents (Malinol, Permount, Histoclad, etc).
Exchange solution to 10% sucrose in PB.
Shake gently for 30 min to 1 h.
Exchange solution to 15% sucrose in PB.
Shake gently for 30 min to 1 h.
Exchange solution to 20% sucrose in PB.
Shake gently for 30 min to 1 h.
Freeze samples with OCT compound.
